features.title: Everything You Need
features.subtitle: Six local-first workflows built for photographers and retouchers

items.title: Ingest & Rename
items.description: Import from multiple sources, equalize camera clocks, preview names, and safely copy or move photo and video files.

items.title: Resize
items.description: Resize JPEG, PNG, TIFF, and WebP batches by width, height, long edge, or percentage with copy-to-clipboard results.

items.title: Minimize
items.description: Optimize losslessly or compress to a chosen quality or target size while retaining source files.

items.title: Sequence Grouper
items.description: Detect HDR, panorama, focus-stack, and burst sequences completely offline, then review every grouping.

items.title: Metadata Cleaner
items.description: Audit private tags, apply Safe Share, and verify protected copyright, capture, color, and orientation data after cleaning.

items.title: Before/After Packager
items.description: Create still comparisons, self-contained HTML sliders, GIFs, and H.264 videos from reviewed pairs.

items.title: Organize into Date Subfolders
items.description: Automatically create YYYY-MM-DD subfolders inside the output folder, grouping your renamed files by shooting day.

items.title: Paired JPG + RAW Handling
items.description: Keep JPG and RAW files paired together. Enable 'Only paired files' to skip any file that doesn't have a matching counterpart.

items.title: Real-Time Color-Coded Log
items.description: Watch every file operation happen in real time. Each log entry shows the full source path and destination path with color-coded status tags.

items.title: Automatic Updates
items.description: LightOps checks GitHub Releases for new versions on startup and notifies you in-app. Update with one click — no manual downloads needed.

items.title: Video File Support
items.description: Scan and rename companion video files (.mp4, .mov, .mts, .m4v, .avi, .mkv, .3gp) alongside your photos in a single pass.

items.title: Preset Manager
items.description: Save your entire configuration as a named preset and restore it with one click. Perfect for recurring workflows like different camera bodies or event types.

items.title: Log Table View
items.description: Switch the log panel between text and table mode. Table mode shows STATUS / SOURCE / DESTINATION columns with clickable paths that open the folder in your OS file manager.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: From SD card to organized library in 4 simple steps

steps.title: Add Your Source Folders
steps.description: Drag and drop or browse to add one or more folders containing your photos. Perfect for pulling from multiple SD cards simultaneously.

steps.title: Configure Your Settings
steps.description: Choose your camera brand to auto-fill RAW extensions. Set a filename format, prefix, and output folder. Preview the output filename in real time.

steps.title: Preview with Dry Run
steps.description: Click 'Dry Run' to see exactly what will happen — every file's source and destination path — without touching any files. Review the full log before committing.

steps.title: Run and Relax
steps.description: Hit 'Run'. Watch the real-time log as LightOps renames and organizes your files. A progress bar tracks every file processed.

highlights: Video support: scan and rename .mp4, .mov, .mts, .m4v, .avi, .mkv, .3gp companion files alongside photos
Preset Manager: save, load, and delete named configuration presets stored locally
Log table mode: toggle between text log and table view with clickable paths that open folders in your OS file manager
Preserve original extension case during rename (e.g. .JPG stays .JPG, .NEF stays .NEF)
Sequence counter (NNNN) now zero-pads to 4 digits instead of 6
Multi-source folder support with drag & drop
Camera presets: Nikon, Canon, Sony, Fujifilm, Panasonic, Olympus, Pentax, Leica
Dry run mode for safe preview
